payload.core_mechanism_summary: Two-pass 1D DP computing each block's operation time as min of its height and neighboring times+1, then taking max.
payload.rationale: The solution uses two linear scans (left-to-right and right-to-left) on a 1D array, computing dp[i]=min(h[i], dp[i-1]+1, dp[i+1]+1). This is classic 1D DP, not 2D.
